skills.name: openx-connection-guide
skills.title: OpenX connection guide
skills.description: Rules for every OpenX call: instances, accounts, errors, confirmation. Read before your first call.

skills.name: openx-deal-creation
skills.title: Create a deal
skills.description: Create a new OpenX XP deal (with its targeting package) through the OpenX MCP tools, including resolving format, device, channel and geo targeting ids, demand partners, the format/channel/device compatibility and targeting-blocking rules (CTV vs viewability/VTR, Banner/Native vs TV devices, App-only/Web-only blocks), and avoiding the backend pitfalls that make createDeal fail or leave orphaned packages. Use whenever someone asks to create, set up, build, or make a new deal in OpenX, even casually ("create me a new deal", "set up a test deal for a Zurich mobile banner", "make a deal for TTD"), or when someone asks which formats, devices, channels or quality thresholds (viewability, VTR) can be combined in a deal, what deal type or pricing (floor vs fixed price) a new deal gets, or when a deal creation attempt has failed and needs recovery.

skills.name: openx-deal-troubleshooter
skills.title: Troubleshoot a deal
skills.description: Troubleshoot OpenX deal performance end to end — health checks, funnel bottlenecks, bid-loss reasons, hourly spikes/drops, daily trends, dimension breakdowns, targeting inspection and audit-trail changes. Use whenever someone gives a deal code (OX-...) or deal name and asks why it's underdelivering, where the funnel leaks, why bids are losing (overall or by publisher, DSP, domain or bundle), what changed, how a deal is pacing, which targeting setting is throttling it, or wants a general "deal health check" — even if they don't name a specific tool. Also use to resolve an OX-... deal code to its numeric id when other OpenX tools need one.

skills.name: openx-audience-build
skills.title: Build an audience
skills.description: Build, size, price and activate an OpenXSelect audience through the OpenX MCP tools - turn a plain-language description of who a campaign should reach into segments, a compiled definition, a reach estimate, a price, a saved audience and an export you can check on. Use when asked to find, build, size, estimate, price, create, edit or activate an audience in OpenXSelect, to turn a persona or RFP audience brief into a targetable audience, to answer "how many people are X in Y", or to check whether an audience has finished publishing. For the deal that will target the audience (publishers, domains, apps, geo of the ad request), use openx-deal-creation instead.
